issues.legal_issue: A property suit connected with matrimonial disputes may be transferred when related proceedings are pending at the requested forum and transfer is needed to give the applicant a fair opportunity to defend.
material_facts: A spouse sought transfer of a pending suit for injunction concerning a flat, claiming that the other spouse had brought it as part of the parties’ matrimonial dispute.
The applicant claimed ownership of the flat and had been added as a defendant after the court found her to be a necessary party; the suit had initially named only her father.
The applicant had left the flat and was living with her parents elsewhere after alleging physical and mental harassment.
Related matrimonial and criminal proceedings were continuing at the requested forum, and an earlier proceeding for restitution of conjugal rights between the spouses had been transferred there.
The other spouse had also filed a second suit concerning the same flat and later withdrawn it.
The Court considered the applicant’s difficulty in defending proceedings at the original forum and concluded that transfer would better serve the ends of justice.
issues.conclusion: The transfer petition was allowed, and the pending property suit was transferred to the requested forum so the applicant could have a fair opportunity to defend it.
issues.legal_principle: A transfer may be ordered when, in the circumstances of a civil proceeding, transfer better serves the ends of justice and affords a party a fair opportunity to defend. No statutory provision was cited. The Court relied on the circumstances of the related matrimonial and property proceedings, including its earlier transfer of a related restitution proceeding.

predicates.civil_suit_transfer_petition: A party sought transfer of a pending civil suit to another forum.
predicates.property_suit_connected_to_matrimonial_d: The property suit arose in the context of a dispute between spouses.
predicates.related_proceedings_pending_at_requested: Proceedings arising from the spouses’ dispute were continuing at the forum to which transfer was sought.
predicates.applicant_has_material_interest_in_prope: The applicant claimed an interest in the property and was a party to the suit.
predicates.applicant_faces_difficulty_defending_at_: The applicant faced practical difficulty defending the suit at the forum where it was pending.

issues.definition: When a party seeks transfer of a civil suit connected to a matrimonial dispute, related proceedings are pending at the requested forum, the applicant has a material interest in the property, and defending at the original forum is difficult, the suit is transferred to the requested forum for a fair defence.
